1.explanation:
• ComboBox/ComboBox.mdx: Describes the ComboBox API—including accepted props and examples—so we know how ref should be supported.  
• ComboBox/tools/: Contains any stories, test utilities, or helper code for ComboBox to inspect how refs are (or aren’t) used in examples/tests.  
• TextInput/TextInput.mdx: Shows how a similar functional input component implements ref forwarding; we can mirror its approach.  
• ListBox/README.md: The ComboBox builds on ListBox internally; understanding its implementation helps trace where ref support might be dropped.  
• MultiSelect/MultiSelect.mdx: Another picker-based component that may forward refs; comparing its implementation surface helps guide adding ref support to ComboBox.  
• Dropdown/Dropdown.mdx: A related dropdown component that should forward refs to its inner trigger; its pattern can illustrate how to apply forwardRef in ComboBox.
1.bug_scenario: The issue occurs when attempting to pass a ref prop to the ComboBox component and expecting to receive a DOM node (for focus or direct manipulation). Because ComboBox was rewritten from a class component to a functional component without using React.forwardRef(), any ref passed into <ComboBox ref={...} /> triggers the warning “Function components cannot be given refs. Attempts to access this ref will fail. Did you mean to use React.forwardRef()?” and the ref callback is never called. The screenshot shows this console warning when rendering a ComboBox with a ref callback.
